title: 18 — Stat Surround / Callout Radial (Lifestyle Flatlay)
description: Stat radial like 13, but the hero is a hand holding the product mid-use within a lifestyle flatlay scene. Background is white with scattered lifestyle props filling the corners and edges (food plates, fruit, accessories) slightly out of focus. A filled banner headline runs across the top. Works when the product is experiential (food, drinks, wellness items you use daily).
